description: This file defines data transfer objects (DTOs) related to Root Cause Analysis (Rca) in a Spring Boot backend project. It contains two record classes, RcaUpsertRequest and RcaResponse, used for data exchange in API interactions.

classes.name: RcaDtos
classes.description: Container class for RcaUpsertRequest and RcaResponse DTOs.

classes.name: RcaDtos.RcaUpsertRequest
classes.description: Data record for creating or updating RCA entries, captures multiple 'why' questions and the root cause.

classes.name: RcaDtos.RcaResponse
classes.description: Data record representing the response containing RCA details, including IDs and 'why' answers.
